summary: First Merchants Corporation filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.37 per common share, payable June 19, 2026, to holders of record as of June 5, 2026. This is a routine capital-return event from the issuer's perspective. There are no special-situation dynamics such as an activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or tender offer. The filing solely updates shareholders on a standard dividend declaration with no structural or M&A implications. The press release is furnished as an exhibit. No advisors, premiums, break fees, or regulatory clocks are referenced. This is a routine current report that does not qualify as a special situation.
